{"consolidated_memory":"ui/components/DataTable.tsx: Blank render issue (multiple occasions)

The web ui component ui/components/DataTable.tsx has experienced blank render (empty tbody with no console error) on two separate occasions, both reproducible by opening the table with a saved column layout. Stack: TypeScript. Covering test: ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx.

OCCASION 1 [2026-04-10]:
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #2490 on branch fix/blank-render-1
- Measured outcome: error rate dropped from 3.5 percent to under 3 per ten thousand

OCCASION 2 [2026-08-13]:
- Trigger: first request after cold start
- Root cause: a listener was registered but never removed, causing a memory leak
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #9499 on branch fix/blank-render-2
- Measured outcome: memory settled at 67 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB"}
